seg.seg_note: Five segments: Test & Measurement, Environmental, Life Sciences & Diagnostics, Dental, Industrial Technologies (+ 'Other' = unallocated corporate). Release has no segment table; segment sales / operating profit from 10-Q segment note (three-month columns), segment growth components and combined 'Depreciation and amortization' (dep_amort, extra field; separate dep / amort not published) from 10-Q MD&A segment sections. other_op_profit = 'Other' -24.6 + 'Equity method earnings of Apex joint venture' 0.0 (Apex JV sold Feb-2013). Test & Measurement includes the communications businesses (split off into NetScout in 2015). Growth sign convention: the 2013 release / 10-Q 'Components of Revenue/Sales Growth' tables present additive components (core/existing + acquisitions + currency = total); values here are stored in the schema's deduction convention (total + acq + fx = core), i.e. acq and fx have the opposite sign to the printed table.
